cause_quote: The original Worktrees page rendered the cleanup label with `${this.loading ? t("common.loading") : t("worktrees.cleanNow")}`, and `load()` set `this.loading = true` before requesting `worktrees.list`.
user_saw: The Worktrees cleanup button showed “Loading…” during an inventory read, and the mobile action group shifted when “Clean up now” returned.
summary: The cleanup button now shows “Loading…” only while cleanup is running.
reasoning: The commit that introduced the Worktrees page already used the inventory-loading flag to select the cleanup label, so ordinary reads could change it from the first release. I checked the Solid port and the blamed readiness refactor, both of which retained the inventory-loading condition.
